name: Unoki
tagline: Shibuya in 29 minutes and Shinagawa in 29 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Ota City, served by Tokyu Tamagawa Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 48 minutes to Otemachi, 39 minutes to Shinjuku, 29 minutes to Shibuya and 29 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 5.7 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 10.6 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 5.7 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 4.3 m to 14.9 m, a difference of 10.6 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 6 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 3 to 5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is about average for the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 11 clinics and 8 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 池田動物病院, about 19 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 田園調布中央病院, about 26 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyu Tamagawa Line.
congestion: Tokyu Tamagawa Line runs at 112% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 矢口渡→蒲田, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥130,000 to ¥140,000 and 2LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. schools and parks within walking distance and quiet surroundings pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station holds it down. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. neighbours.lead: Unoki is ahead on lower rent, and little else separates the two.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Unoki. It is served by the same lines as Unoki. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. A one-room flat costs about ¥5,000 more at Shimomaruko.

neighbours.lead: For how little of the area is in the flood projection, Kugahara; for how close the centre is, Unoki.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Unoki. Kugahara has the Tokyu Ikegami Line, a different set from Unoki. To Shibuya, for instance, Kugahara takes 4 minutes longer. On how little of the area is in the flood projection, Kugahara comes out ahead.

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 5 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 4 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyu Tamagawa Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are very lightly loaded in the morning.
